New York: A woman followed a Jewish man from the Diamond District, then stabbed him with a needle on 47th Street.

NYPD's Hate Crimes Task Force is probing Wednesday's attack as a bias crime. The 26-year-old victim is stable at Bellevue Hospital; no arrest made.

Jewish New Yorkers have been targeted in over half this year's hate crimes, about 12% of NYC's population.
